entries.title: Your first mate waits for your answer before starting work its card asks about
entries.body: When your first mate asks on a card whether to start a task, it can no longer start that task before you answer. It starts the task after you choose on the card or tell your first mate to go ahead, so choosing to leave it in the backlog never finds a crewmate already working on it.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the fix stops a start that came before your answer.
